note: The section header of the attacker-controlled .rel.text relocation section is read straight from the input ELF; in the PoC its sh_entsize field is 0 (no sanity check on sh_entsize exists in this version).
The relocation section descriptor records the raw ELF section header (with sh_entsize == 0) so that the later relocation-collection pass can access it.
bpf_object__collect_relos() dispatches every recorded SEC_RELO section to bpf_object__collect_prog_relos() with the unvalidated shdr.

Root cause: the number of relocations is computed as sh_size / sh_entsize without first checking that sh_entsize is non-zero. A crafted SHT_REL section with sh_entsize == 0 reaches this unguarded division.
Sink: integer division by zero (SIGFPE) because shdr->sh_entsize == 0, crashing the process while parsing the crafted ELF relocations.
